# Specs

<!-- Generated by seed-golden-context | Last updated: 2026-05-11 -->

This directory holds implementation-level specs for active or recently completed work.

**Format:** `YYYY-MM-<spec-name>.md`

Specs capture "what we're building now" in enough detail for both humans and agents to produce coherent, safe changes. Once work ships, mark the spec `status: done` rather than deleting it — it becomes a useful reference for why things look the way they do.

No active specs at time of seeding. Add one when scoping a new feature or bug fix.
